component.name: Universal Mod Multitool
component.summary: Evil Islands modding toolkit: converters, 3D viewer and map editor

description.p: The Universal Mod's toolkit for Evil Islands (Cursed Lands): converts the game's textures, configs and archives, edits and compares the gameplay database, shows units, items and figures in a 3D viewer, and edits maps and quests with checks that follow the game's own rules, a difficulty rating and a node editor for mission scripts.
